thread:
ahmed: getting swamped with pages from canary-probe-eu-west starting ~02:58 UTC. ~90 alerts in 8m. No spike in customer errors. flagging.

oncall-bot: Alert (P3) — canary-probe-eu-west flapping. Pager: @kevin

kevin (oncall): I’m taking it. Can someone share last minute of probe samples + probe config? Want to check how many fails required.

elena (eng-infra): quick dump:
```json
{"ts":"2026-03-15T02:58:01Z","latency_ms":95,"status":"ok"}
{"ts":"2026-03-15T02:58:11Z","latency_ms":210,"status":"warn"}
{"ts":"2026-03-15T02:58:21Z","latency_ms":480,"status":"fail"}
{"ts":"2026-03-15T02:58:31Z","latency_ms":120,"status":"ok"}
```
Probes are 10s freq, alert on 1 failure. bursts line up with short client traffic bursts.

natalie (sre): yeah that 1-fail rule is asking for noise. recommendation: change to 2 out of 3 failures or switch to 30s frequency during this window. Also add jitter tolerance.

ahmed: customer logs + api p95 look steady. support queue zero. feels safe to relax for eu-west.

elena (eng-infra): proposed temporary roll (eu-west only):
```yaml
probe: canary-probe-eu-west
frequency_seconds: 30
consecutive_failures_required: 2
alert_mode: metrics-only
canary_targets: [cw-eu-01, cw-eu-02]
```
Will canary to 2 hosts and monitor.

kevin (oncall): +1. roll to canaries. keep paging suppressed but emit metrics events to ops channel.

deploy-bot: Rolling patch r-20260315-eu-backoff to cw-eu-01,cw-eu-02. Started.

deploy-bot: Roll complete. r-20260315-eu-backoff -> cw-eu-01,cw-eu-02

elena (eng-infra): after canary, alert volume dropped to 1/min from 18/min. good sign. will hold for 30m then roll region-wide if stable.

product-support: checking if any customers reported issues — none so far. good.

ahmed: ran synthetic trace against the customer path — p50/p95 unchanged. tagging for post-incident.

natalie (sre): actions: 1) keep temp config for 4h, 2) create combined dashboard panel: canary-probe-fail-count + backend p50/p95 + host scheduling CPU, 3) update runbook to prefer 2/3 confirmation for synthetics and to check client-side burst patterns, 4) refactor probe system to support dynamic backoff based on baseline variance. owners: Elena(dash+config), Ahmed(verification), Kevin(runbook).

kevin (oncall): will add a short annotation to the alert history: "suppressed due to noisy canary probes; temp config applied". handing to @maria at 06:00 UTC.

maria (oncall): ack, monitoring. will revert if pages resume.

elena (eng-infra): created dashboard: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/efgh5678/canary-eu-west-overview and added panel for probe noise.

ahmed: filing follow-up ticket RW-1620 "Canary probe tuning: eu-west false positives". Owner: Elena. ETA: 1 week.

oncall-bot: Incident status: mitigated (paging suppressed, monitoring in watch). This channel will auto-close in 2h if no recurrence.

---
Post-incident summary:
- Impact: No customer-facing errors; high alert noise generated operator overhead.
- Short term: increased probe window to 2/3 consecutive failures, reduced frequency for eu-west; suppressed pages but retained metrics.
- Medium term: dashboard and runbook updates, ticket RW-1620 for probe system improvements (dynamic backoff, jitter tolerance).
- Owners: Elena (infra), Natalie (SRE), Ahmed (verification), Kevin (oncall runbook).

kevin (oncall): handing off to next oncall. stay alert in case of recurrence.
